title: import wizard: a failed import (405, request error, failed background job, every row rejected) still shows the green check and "Import Complete"
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named site and a named real producer.** Follow-up owed by the landed objectui#13124 (PR #13186, ACCEPT §7). Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectui#5560, `session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`) from a read-only census it ran to measure a finding booked on a landed card. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat.

## The defect
The import wizard's result step always draws a green check and "Import Complete", even when nothing was imported.

- **Site:** `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx:3110`–`:3121`. `result.cancelled ? <X/> + importCancelled : <CheckCircle2 className="h-10 w-10 text-green-500"/> + importComplete` has no failure arm. The badges at `:3127`–`:3138` draw "0 imported" in the primary variant.
- **Measured** with the real `ImportWizard` (vitest and happy-dom, objectui `main` `5c12dcd`). Every case read "Import Complete" with the green check:
  - (a) all rows created: "2 created";
  - (b) some rows failed: "1 created", "1 skipped" and a row error;
  - (c) every row failed: "0 imported", "2 skipped";
  - (d1) the import rejected with 405: "0 imported", "2 skipped", "This object is not open for import.";
  - (d2) the request throws: "0 imported", "2 skipped", "Network request failed";
  - (e) a background job ends `failed`: "0 imported", "Worker crashed".
- The headline's own text is `text-foreground` (`RESULT_HEADLINE_CLASS`). The green is the icon beside it, and the dialog's accessible description reads "Import Complete" in all six cases.

## reach
- **Public entry:** the console object list's Import (`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:4137`; also `ExcelImportBar.tsx:205`).
- **Named real producer of (d1):** objectstack answers 405 `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` for an object not open for import (objectstack#3391, handled at `ImportWizard.tsx:1020`–`:1025`).
- Failure results reach the success arm from `:2702`–`:2721`, `:2738`–`:2748`, `:2750`–`:2771` and `:2589`–`:2591`.

## Expected
The result step says what happened:
- a success state only when rows were imported;
- a partial-success state when some rows were skipped;
- a failure state (no green check, no "Import Complete") when nothing was imported or the request or job failed.

The counts and row errors stay as they are.

## Dedupe
Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed.
- "import wizard shows Import Complete when import failed": 5 hits, none on point (objectui#13124, #13015, #12697, #12985 and #2163, all closed; objectui#13124 only moved the headline).
- "ImportWizard result screen success headline green check every row failed 405": the same 5, none on point.

**New.** Dedupe words: Import Complete failed import; import result failure state; green check 0 imported.
